reason: I have one apartment right next to my house, so when a guest needs something they knock on my door or send me a WhatsApp and I answer. €120 is a lot of money for me to pay for something I already do myself for free.
objection: If the AI tells a German guest the wrong check-out time or sends them to a closed beach, I get the bad review, not Almissa Digital, and with one apartment one bad review hurts me for the whole season.
would_change_my_mind: If my cousin or a neighbour with the same kind of apartment used it for a full summer and showed me it got no complaints and saved real time, and the price was closer to €40 for the season.
